title: BioScope
description: An interactive biodiversity platform that simulates the ecological impact of species removal. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Snowflake, and Google Gemini. Won 1st Place in UI/UX at DataHacks 2026.

title: Browser Eats
description: An AI-powered food delivery comparison application that uses parallel browser agents to compare prices across DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub. Built with Next.js, Playwright, browser automation, and Supabase.

title: TubeScope
description: An interactive data science application analyzing YouTube trending video lifespans using survival analysis and Kaplan-Meier estimators. Built with Python, pandas, and Streamlit.

title: PantryPal
description: A recipe recommendation application that uses image classification to recognize ingredients and suggest meals. Combines convolutional neural networks with the USDA FoodData Central API.

title: US Power Outage Analysis
description: An exploratory data analysis of major US power outages from 2000 to 2016, investigating outage severity, geographic patterns, population density, and underlying causes. Created using Python, pandas, and Plotly.

title: UCSD Lecture Attendance Analysis
description: A data science project exploring relationships between lecture attendance, student experiences, and academic performance at UC San Diego. Used Python, web scraping, pandas, and VADER sentiment analysis.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: Placeholder project exploring weather patterns through interactive charts and visualizations.

title: Movie Recommendation System
description: Placeholder project demonstrating a movie recommendation interface based on user preferences.

title: Fitness Activity Tracker
description: Placeholder project displaying daily activity trends and fitness statistics.

title: Spotify Listening Analysis
description: Placeholder project visualizing music listening habits, genres, and favorite artists.

title: Student Budget Planner
description: Placeholder project demonstrating expense tracking and monthly budget summaries.

description: Placeholder project showcasing destination comparisons and travel-related data visualizations.
